articles.summary: Agent editing comes to Diffusion Studio with the Mac app and dapi. The editor is now open source.
articles.title: Diffusion Studio for Mac

articles.summary: Projects now live locally, with code as the database for your video projects. Agents can work directly from the source code, your editing decisions can become reusable skills, and every change can be tracked with Git.
articles.title: Code as the source of truth
